title: AudioStreamRandomizer doesn't always play (or emit finished)
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.4.1.stable.mono.official [49a5bc7b6]
- v4.5.stable.mono.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 7 1700 Eight-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

Setting an AudioStreamRandomizer as the stream of an AudioStreamPlayer and calling play() doesn't always result in it playing. The AudioStreamPlayer's playing property will say its playing, and it will never emit the finished signal. 

In my MRP the thunder sound only plays about half the time when using the AudioStreamRandomizers, but when setting the Lightning Node's sound properties to use any of the individual AudioStreams the randomizers use it will work every time.

I'm using an AudioMgr script which is an object pool of AudioStreamPlayers, since the sounds don't always emit the finished signal (since they don't start playing), I continuously create new AudioStreamPlayers instead of removing them from the tree and then reusing later.

### Steps to reproduce

Open the MRP and press play, if it's not system dependent, you'll notice that the thunder sounds don't play on every lightning strike. Open the remote scene tree and look at the children of the AudioMgr node. When working properly there will range between 0-3 AudioStreamPlayer nodes under it as new sounds are played, and old sounds finished. This happens if you swap the Lightning node's sound_close and sound_distance properties to the individual .wav AudioStreams rather than the AudioStreamRandomizers. However, with the randomizers, this number will grow over time to much more than 3, as often the sound isn't played and the finished signal never emitted to tell the AudioMgr script to remove and reuse the AudioStreamPlayers. You'll also notice at some points there's no sound playing at all but there's still AudioStreamPlayers in the scene which if you inspect them say they're playing.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[audiostreamraondmizerbug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22502858/audiostreamraondmizerbug.zip)
